$comment: GPL ffmpeg for imageio-ffmpeg, built by build/build-ffmpeg.py. builtin-baseline pins the vcpkg commit and with it every port version; update it with build/update-vcpkg.py. Features marked (imageio) are added to vcpkg's ffmpeg port from build/vcpkg/ffmpeg-port/.

features.$comment: drawtext filter (freetype + harfbuzz; without fontconfig, so fontfile= is needed).
features.name: drawtext

features.$comment: TLS for https; Windows uses schannel. OpenSSL 3 implies version3 (GPLv3).
features.name: openssl

features.$comment: srt and sftp protocols (libsrt and libssh use OpenSSL themselves; on Windows ffmpeg's TLS stays on schannel).
features.name: srt

features.$comment: (imageio) rtmpe/rtmpte protocols on Windows, where ffmpeg has no OpenSSL (it would replace schannel, which uses the Windows certificate store).
features.name: gmp

features.$comment: (imageio) V4L2 mem2mem hardware codecs (e.g. Raspberry Pi).
features.name: v4l2m2m

features.$comment: GPU encoders/decoders; driver libraries are loaded at runtime if present.
features.name: nvcodec
